run_guided_backprop: run guided backprop on a model using GuidedBackpropContext to compute saliency maps
get_example_data: get example data including a model, input tensor, and category ID for benchmarking
gradient_to_saliency: convert a tensor's gradient into a saliency map using gradient_to_saliency
plot_example: plot an input tensor alongside its saliency map with a label and category ID
requires_grad: enable gradient tracking on a tensor by calling requires_grad_ with True
